items.claim: Lopez has been knocked out three times in his mixed martial arts career, with back-to-back knockout losses coming into this fight.
items.quote: Lopez been knocked out three times in his Zuf in his mixed martial arts career. Three of which have been under the Zuva banner, one in the contender series, back-to-back L's coming in this one by knockout as well.

items.claim: Tai Miller is undefeated with a 7-0 record.
Tai Miller landed 59 significant strikes in the first round against Adam Fugit.
items.quote: 59 significant strikes for Ty Miller in the first five minutes of the bout.

items.claim: Tai Miller looked much faster than Adam Fugit and his strikes did significantly more damage.
items.quote: He looked quick. He looked way faster than Fugit. And at least the strikes that Miller was landing was doing. It was doing a lot more damage than what Fugit was landing on the other side.
